# opencode-cron

> ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks for opencode — session-bound cron + persistent markdown memory for AI agents, by Culture Digitali Srl.

opencode-cron is an open-source (MIT) plugin for opencode that brings ChatGPT-style Scheduled Tasks to AI coding agents. Unlike plain cron, it re-prompts the same AI session on every scheduled tick with persistent memory, so the agent keeps full context, deduplicates alerts, and avoids burning tokens.

## Key facts
- Name: opencode-cron (npm: @culturedigitali/opencode-cron), version 1.0.0, license MIT.
- Made by: Culture Digitali Srl. Creator & lead developer: Luigi Strazzullo.
- Repository: https://github.com/CultureDigitali/opencode-cron
- Launch site: https://culturedigitali.github.io/opencode-cron/

## Core capabilities
- Same conversation every tick: re-prompts the same sessionID with full history (not a detached CLI call).
- Persistent markdown memory that survives context compaction, restarts and reboots; tracks seenHashes to prevent repeat alerts.
- Compaction hook re-injects the job's memory file into the compaction summary.
- Mission Control Web GUI on http://localhost:4488 (jobs, live SQLite session streaming, memory studio, execution timeline).
- Cross-platform desktop app + system tray (macOS .dmg, Windows .exe, Linux .AppImage/.deb).
- 1-click "Imposta Cron" schedule binding with natural-language schedule previews.
- 9 native agent tools (cron_add, cron_list, cron_get, cron_pause, cron_resume, cron_remove, cron_run_now, cron_memory_read, cron_memory_save) + 5 slash commands.
- Autonomous background daemon via launchd (macOS), systemd (Linux), schtasks (Windows), 60s ticker.
- 10-language i18n suite: English, Italiano, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, 中文, 日本語, Русский, العربية (RTL).

## Reliability guardrails
- Minimum 60s interval, up to 10% jitter, optional maxRuns cap, skip-if-running atomic locks, auto-pause after 5 consecutive failures.

## Install
```jsonc
// opencode.json
{ "plugins": ["@culturedigitali/opencode-cron"] }
```
Background execution: `npx @culturedigitali/opencode-cron os-install`
